The five selected, unmodified 4096-pixel maps are color, opacity, ambient
occlusion, roughness, and OpenGL normal. Godot samples all five in the cobweb
material. The unused DirectX normal, height map, archive and macOS resource forks
are deliberately excluded. Runtime texture imports are limited to 2048 pixels
with mipmaps. This preserves the detailed source without requiring 4K sampling.
